description: arXiv:2609.08115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) pretraining relies on an auxiliary load-balancing loss (LBL) to drive per-expert utilization toward uniformity. Post-training inherits a different situation: the base router already encodes non-uniform expert co-activation structure, which a re-imposed uniformity objective flattens away.
